newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SUKER DOUBLE-STRIKE HELPS REAL FORGET PROBLEMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SUKER DOUBLE-STRIKE HELPS REAL FORGET PROBLEMS.

text.p: Real Madrid shook off their internal problems and an early goal from Sporting Gijon to score a convincing 3-1 Spanish league win on Sunday.
Davor Suker ended his goal drought to find the net twice, and set-piece specialist Roberto Carlos thundered home another as Real took a provisional 11-point lead over Barcelona, who play on Monday.
Throughout the game Real fans shouted insults at coach Fabio Capello, who five days earlier had announced his decision to leave the club at the end of the season.
Most other games in the Spanish championship kicked off an hour later.
